summary: c1 was required and blocked before the change and remains blocked afterward by the same header-derived output capacity.

claims.necessity_reason: Successful single-call decompression of the finite valid 63,241-byte Huffman stream is supported on both sides when adequate output space is supplied.

before.requirement: Complete single-call decompression of the 63,241-byte fixed-Huffman zlib stream using the previous tree-clearing operation.
before.reason: The previous decoder accepts the header and builds fixed Huffman trees, but the old harness supplies at most 63,240 output bytes and makes no retry.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The unchanged header check bounds the first input byte of an accepted stream.
Output exhaustion prevents completion of Huffman decoding.

after.requirement: Complete single-call decompression of the same 63,241-byte fixed-Huffman zlib stream using the new tree-clearing helper.
after.reason: The new helper is called during fixed-Huffman tree construction, while the same harness capacity remains below the required output size.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: This is the helper invoked by the changed call.
The header check and block dispatch apply to the same witness.
Output exhaustion prevents completion of Huffman decoding.

claims.comparison_reason: Both versions parse the same header and build fixed Huffman trees. The old harness derives the same insufficient capacity from the first two bytes on both sides; the changed clearing operation does not alter that constraint.
